sample.biological_model: OVX mouse muscle crush-injury model under simulated aeromedical transport with placebo treatment
sample.biological_source: Right lateral gastrocnemius from female C57BL/6NHsd mice
sample.sample_material: Total RNA extracted from the injured right lateral gastrocnemius, collected 192 h after crush injury. A subcutaneous placebo 60-day-release pellet was implanted 7 days before injury. Right gastrocnemius and quadriceps muscle groups underwent closed-crush injury at 45 psi for 30 s per application, repeated 2–4 times; individual repetition counts are not assigned. All mice underwent mild hypobaria at 565 ± 5 torr for 8 h starting 22–24 h after injury to simulate medical air transport.

sample.biological_model: OVX mouse muscle crush-injury model under simulated aeromedical transport with 17β-estradiol replacement
sample.biological_source: Right lateral gastrocnemius from female C57BL/6NHsd mice
sample.sample_material: Total RNA extracted from the injured right lateral gastrocnemius, collected 192 h after crush injury. All mice underwent mild hypobaria at 565 ± 5 torr for 8 h starting 22–24 h after injury to simulate medical air transport.
